If the restore also fails, the order monitor raises ONE critical alert through the naked-position alert path (execution_diagnostics.enqueue_rearm_restore_failed: account/symbol/trade_id, 'position may be unprotected'), latched 6 h per trade, and the next tick's sweep retries (no halt, no gate).
